青蛙先生有个怪毛病——他睡觉

床，软软的，又大又舒适，可他没睡多

[P3] 每次，他钻进床底下，用不了两分钟，就进入了甜蜜的梦乡。
那一晚，青蛙先生在床底下睡得正香甜，突然听到轰隆一声巨响，他从梦中惊醒了。他张开眼睛一看，四周黑漆漆的一片，他再仔细一听，到处都是一片安静。
“也许是 我做了个梦吧，并没有发生什么呀！”青蛙先生翻了个身，又想睡了。
022
023

[P4] 突然，他听见有人走进他的屋子的声音，青蛙先生紧张地屏住了气。
“别害怕，刺猬先生！”这是小兔子的声音。
小兔子接着说：“房子塌了没关系，过几天等你病好了，我们再来帮你盖屋。”
“可是，”刺猬先生边咳嗽边说，“这几天怎么办呢？我又生着病，住到哪儿去好呢？”
“你瞧，青蛙先生不在家，也许他出远门去了，你就先住在这儿吧！”
ke

“这怎么好意思呢，主人不在家，我怎么可以住在这儿呢？”刺猬先生不安地说。
“没关系，青蛙先生是一位好心的先生，他知道的话，一定会欢迎你住在这儿的。”小兔子一个劲地安慰刺猬先生。
“你非常了解我！”青蛙先生高兴地自言自语，“我当然乐意帮助一位有困难的朋友。”

[P6] “好吧。”刺猬先生说，“我先借住一下，等他回来后我一定去找地方住，我不能打扰好心的青蛙先生！”
“这就好了。”青蛙先生又自言自语，“在你的病没好以前，我是不会回来的。”
刺猬先生在床上睡了半夜，他不再难受得直哼哼了，咳嗽的次数也减少了許多，他睡得很安稳。
青蛙先生睡在床底下，他把头枕在双手上，眼睛盯着床板想：等
会儿，刺猬先生睡醒了，肚子一定会饿的，得告诉他吃的东西放在哪里。
于是，青蛙先生从床底下探出头来，他轻轻地打开床头柜，拿出纸和笔，写了一封信：

刺猬先生：
你好，欢迎你来我家养病。
qǐng zhù yì zài wǒ jiā shù gài de dì sān gè chǔmén
请注意，在我家橱柜的第三个橱门
lǐ fàng zhe jǐ tīng měiwèi de shípǐn huàntou hái yǒu xīn
里，放着几听美味的食品罐头，还有新
xiān de miànbāo shuì xǐng yǐ hòu qǐng fàng kāi nǐ de wèi

kǒu chī ba yǐn liào zài bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu niú nǎi hái yǒu

jú zǐ jiǔ suí nǐ xuǎnyòng zhù nǐ zǎo rì kāng fù
橘子汁，随你选用。祝你早日康复！
zhèng zài yáo yuǎn guó dù lǚ xíng de nǐ de péngyou
正在遥远国度旅行的你的朋友
qīng wā
青蛙













































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































[P8] 刺猬先生从床上爬起来一看，
床头柜上有一封信。他拿起来一
读，心里热乎乎的。他说：“好心的青蛙先生正在遥远的国度旅行，怎么
知道我的情况的呢？准是谁打电话告诉他了。但这封信是谁送来的呢？是
大雁先生，还是鸽子女士？这事真让人感动。”

刺猬先生找出了吃的，享用了一顿
非常美味的晚餐。

他又睡下了。这时天又暗了下来。
刺猬先生还没睡熟，就听见了打鼾的声音，不过他还以为那是自己打的呢。

[P9] 又是一个白天到来了。
刺猬先生一睁开眼，就看见床头柜上又放着一封信。他打开信纸一看——

刺猬先生：
你的病痊愈了吧，但你一定还很虚弱，请别走出门去，外面太冷，你会感冒的。
请打开电视机看电视吧，今天下午有连续剧《乌鸦女巫和她的奇妙魔术》，我想你是爱看的。上午呢，你可以看些书，我的大橱柜的第二个橱门里，有很多有趣的书。
我快从遥远的国度回来了，我们很快会见面的。

你的朋友
青蛙

[P10] 刺猬先生看了信，不知有多高兴。
他照青蛙先生的意见办，上午看书，
下午看电视，度过了愉快的一天。
第二天早上，一声鸡鸣惊醒了刺猬先生。他觉得自己的身体完全恢复了，精神好极了。
他正想起床，忽然听到一阵打鼾声。
他以为自己又睡着了，可是自己明明是醒着的呀，怎么可能打起呼噜来呢？
刺猬先生再侧耳细听，这声音是从床底上传来的。

[P11] “谁躲在床底下？”刺猬先生吓了一大跳。
他蹦下床，撩起床单一看，在他睡觉的软软的床下，睡着他的朋友青蛙先生。
青蛙先生也被惊醒了，他起先惊奇地看着刺猬先生，后来就愉快地笑了。
刺猬先生紧紧地拥抱从床底下钻出来的青蛙先生。他说：“老天，你的遥远的国度就在我的身子下面，

[P12] 就在这昏暗的床底下。你寄自遥远
国度的信，就是从床底下发出的。你
太让我感动了，你怎么可以这样对待
自己，你怎么可以和我开这样的玩笑？
我真想打你几下呢……”
青蛙先生笑得弯下了腰。他说：
“这真是有趣的两天。不过，我只能像
老鼠一样，在半夜里你睡着的时候，才
出来偷吃一点东西，可把我饿坏了，咱
们快享用一顿丰盛的早餐吧！别忘
了，今天我还要帮你盖新房呢！”
这时，门外响起了一阵敲门声。
啊，是小兔子和其他几个伙伴一起来
了。

[P13] 窗外,太阳高高升起,大家高兴地对刺猬先生说:“干起来吧,这真是一个盖房子的好天气!”

[P1] 003
A Letter from Under the Bed
ji
zi
chuang
di
de
xin
019

[P2] qīng wā xiānsheng yǒu gè guàimáo bìng——tā shuì jiào
xǐ huān shuì zài chuáng dǐ xià
Mr. Frog has a strange habit—he likes to sleep under the bed.
qīng wā xiānsheng jiā lǐ yǒu yì zhāng jí hǎo de
chuáng ruǎnruǎn de yòu dà yòu shū shì kě tā méi shuì duō
jiǔ jiù jué de húnshēnsuāntòng
Mr. Frog has a very good bed at home—soft, big, and comfortable, but after sleeping on it for a short while, he feels sore all over.
qīng wā xiānsheng yīn wèi shuì guàn le yìng bǎn chuáng
Mr. Frog is used to sleeping on a hard board bed,
ér qiě nián jì yòu dà le yì diǎn méi fǎ shì yìng zhè zhāng
xīn mǎi lái de ruǎnchuáng
and since he is a bit older now, he can't adapt to this new soft bed.
 yú shì tā jiù gàn cuì měi tiān shuì zài dì bǎnshàng
yìng yìng de dì bǎn yòu píng zhǎn yòu shū fu tā hái tè
bié ài shuì zài chuáng dǐ xià de dì bǎnshàng
So, he simply sleeps on the floor every day.
The hard floor is flat and comfortable. He especially loves sleeping on the floor under the bed—
nà lǐ jìng jìng de àn àn de nuǎnnuǎn de zhēn
shì shuì jiào de hǎo dì fāng
It's quiet, dark, and warm—truly a great place to sleep.
Z
Z
Z

[P3] Every time, he crawled under the bed, and within two minutes, he fell into a sweet dream.
That night, Mr. Frog was sleeping soundly under the bed when suddenly he heard a loud boom. He woke up startled. He opened his eyes and saw a pitch-black surroundings. He listened carefully, and everywhere was quiet.
"Maybe I was just dreaming, nothing happened!" Mr. Frog turned over and wanted to go back to sleep.
022
023

[P4] Suddenly, he heard the sound of someone walking into his house. Mr. Frog held his breath nervously.
"Don't be afraid, Mr. Hedgehog!" This was the voice of the little rabbit.
The little rabbit continued, "The house collapsed, but it's okay. Wait a few days until you're better, and we'll come back to help you rebuild it."
"But," Mr. Hedgehog said, coughing, "what should I do for these few days? I'm sick again, where should I stay?"
"Look, Mr. Frog isn't home. Maybe he went on a trip. You can stay here for now!"
ke
ke
ke

[P5] "Yes, I'm away on a trip, you can stay here!" Mr. Frog whispered to himself under the bed.
"How can I possibly stay here? The owner isn't home, how could I?" Mr. Hedgehog said nervously.
"Don't worry, Mr. Frog is a kind-hearted gentleman. If he knew, he'd surely welcome you to stay here," the little rabbit kept comforting Mr. Hedgehog.
"You understand me very well!" Mr. Frog whispered happily to himself, "Of course I'm happy to help a friend in need."

[P6] "Alright," said Mr. Hedgehog, "I'll stay for a while. After he comes back, I'll definitely find a place to live. I can't disturb kind-hearted Mr. Frog!"
"That's settled," Mr. Frog said to himself, "Until your illness is better, I won't be coming back."
Mr. Hedgehog slept on the bed for half the night. He no longer groaned in discomfort, and his coughing decreased greatly. He slept very soundly.
Mr. Frog slept under the bed, resting his head on his hands, staring at the bedboard and thinking: 
Soon, Mr. Hedgehog will wake up, and his stomach will surely be hungry. I must tell him where the food is.
So, Mr. Frog poked his head out from under the bed. He gently opened the bedside table, took out paper and pen, and wrote a letter:

[P8] The hedgehog climbed out of bed and looked around.
There was a letter on the bedside table. He picked it up and read it, feeling warm inside. He said, "The kind frog is traveling far away. How could he know about my situation? Someone must have called him. But who sent this letter? Mr. Goose or Miss Pigeon? This is truly touching."

The hedgehog found some food and enjoyed a very delicious dinner.

He fell asleep again. The sky grew dark once more.
The hedgehog wasn't fully asleep yet when he heard snoring. But he still thought it was his own snoring.

[P9] Another day has come.
When Mr. Hedgehog opened his eyes, he saw another letter on the bedside table. He opened the letter and read——

Dear Mr. Hedgehog:
I hope your illness has healed, but you must still be weak. Please don't go out, it's too cold outside, and you might catch a cold.
Turn on the TV and watch it. This afternoon, there's the serial drama 'The Crow Witch and Her Magical Tricks,' which I know you love. In the morning, you can read some books. In the second door of my big cabinet, there are many interesting books.
I'm coming back from a distant country soon. We'll meet again very soon.

Your friend,
Frog

[P10] Mr. Hedgehog read the letter and was so happy.
He followed Mr. Frog's advice, reading in the morning and watching TV in the afternoon, enjoying a pleasant day.
The next morning, a rooster's crow woke Mr. Hedgehog. He felt his body had fully recovered and was full of energy.
As he was about to get up, he suddenly heard a snoring sound.
He thought he must have fallen asleep again, but he was clearly awake—how could he possibly be snoring?
Mr. Hedgehog listened carefully and realized the sound was coming from under the bed.

[P11] "Who's hiding under the bed?" The hedgehog jumped in surprise.
He jumped out of bed, lifted the bedsheet, and saw his friend, Mr. Frog, sleeping under his soft bed.
Mr. Frog was also awakened. He first looked at the hedgehog in surprise, then smiled happily.
The hedgehog hugged Mr. Frog tightly as he crawled out from under the bed. He said, "Goodness, your distant kingdom is right under my body,

[P12] Right under this dark bed. The letter you sent from your distant kingdom came from under the bed. You've moved me so much—how can you treat yourself like this? How can you play such a joke on me? I really want to give you a few taps...”
The frog先生 laughed until he bent over. He said:
“These have been two fun days. But I could only be like a mouse, coming out to steal a little food in the middle of the night while you were sleeping. I’ve been so hungry! Let’s quickly enjoy a hearty breakfast! Don’t forget—I still need to help you build your new house today!”
At that moment, a knock came at the door.
Ah, it was the little rabbit and a few other friends who had come over.

[P13] Outside, the sun rises high. Everyone happily tells Mr. Hedgehog, "Let's get started! This is a perfect day for building a house!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本的章节标题页，显示标题“寄自床底的信”，并配有兔子图案和拼音注释，页码为019。
[P2] 本页介绍了青蛙先生因为习惯睡硬板床，不适应新买的软床，于是选择睡在地板上，尤其喜欢床底下的地板，因为那里安静、温暖、舒适。
[P3] 青蛙先生在床底下睡得正香时，突然被一声巨响惊醒，他环顾四周发现一片漆黑和安静，以为是做梦，便又准备继续睡觉。
[P4] 青蛙先生的房子塌了，小兔子前来安慰并承诺帮忙重建。刺猬先生因生病无处可住，小兔子建议他暂时住在青蛙先生的房子里。
[P5] 青蛙先生在床底下自言自语，同意刺猬先生暂时住在自己家中，小兔子在一旁安慰刺猬先生，青蛙先生表示乐意帮助有困难的朋友。
[P6] 刺猬先生在青蛙先生的床上睡得安稳，而青蛙先生在床底下为刺猬先生考虑，决定写一封信告诉他食物的位置。
[P8] 刺猬先生收到青蛙先生寄来的信，感到非常感动，并享用了一顿美味晚餐后再次入睡，但因不熟悉新环境，误将自己打鼾的声音当作他人鼾声。
[P9] 青蛙先生写了一封信给刺猬先生，关心他的身体状况，并建议他待在室内、看电视或看书，还告知了自己即将归来，信中充满了温暖的关怀。
[P10] 刺猬先生收到青蛙先生的信后，身体恢复，心情愉快。第二天早上，他准备起床时，突然听到床底传来打鼾声，感到困惑，仔细倾听后发现声音来自床下。
[P11] 刺猬先生在床下发现青蛙先生，起初受惊，随后两人相视而笑并拥抱，刺猬先生幽默地称青蛙先生的‘国度’就在自己身下。
[P12] 刺猬先生发现青蛙先生一直住在床底下，感到十分感动和惊讶。青蛙先生笑着解释自己在半夜偷偷出来吃东西，现在要和刺猬先生一起享用早餐并帮忙盖新房。这时，小兔子和其他伙伴前来拜访。
[P13] 窗外阳光明媚，小动物们高兴地对刺猬先生说今天是盖房子的好天气，准备一起动工。
